{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}
module MQConsumer where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Concurrent.Async
import Control.Exception
import Control.Monad (forever, when, void)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Foreign.Ptr
import Foreign.ForeignPtr
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Foreign.Storable
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Simulates a native message buffer from the MQ C library
data NativeBuffer = NativeBuffer
  { bufPtr    :: Ptr Word
  , bufLen    :: Int
  , bufSeqNo  :: Int
  }

-- Session state for each consumer
data ConsumerSession = ConsumerSession
  { sessionId       :: Int
  , activeBuffer    :: MVar (Maybe NativeBuffer)
  , callbackRef     :: IORef (Maybe (ByteString -> IO ()))
  , sessionAlive    :: TVar Bool
  , pendingAcks     :: TVar (Map Int Bool)
  }

-- Global registry of sessions
sessionRegistry :: TVar (Map Int ConsumerSession)
sessionRegistry = unsafePerformIO $ newTVarIO Map.empty
{-# NOINLINE sessionRegistry #-}

-- Maximum allowed buffer length (element count) to prevent oversized/overflowing allocations
maxBufferLen :: Int
maxBufferLen = 1024 * 1024

allocNativeBuffer :: Int -> Int -> IO NativeBuffer
allocNativeBuffer len seqNo = do
  -- Validate length to avoid negative sizes and integer overflow in (len * 8)
  when (len < 0 || len > maxBufferLen) $
    throwIO (userError ("allocNativeBuffer: invalid buffer length: " ++ show len))
  ptr <- mallocBytes (len * 8)
  return $ NativeBuffer ptr len seqNo

freeNativeBuffer :: NativeBuffer -> IO ()
freeNativeBuffer buf = free (bufPtr buf)

-- Creates a new consumer session
newSession :: Int -> IO ConsumerSession
newSession sid = do
  bufRef <- newMVar Nothing
  cbRef  <- newIORef Nothing
  alive  <- newTVarIO True
  acks   <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  let session = ConsumerSession sid bufRef cbRef alive acks
  atomically $ modifyTVar' sessionRegistry (Map.insert sid session)
  return session

-- Register an async callback that processes messages
-- The callback acquires the MVar lock before accessing the buffer
registerCallback :: ConsumerSession -> IO ()
registerCallback session = do
  let callback msg = do
        withMVar (activeBuffer session) $ \mbuf -> do
          case mbuf of
            Nothing  -> return ()
            Just buf -> do
              -- Process message using the native buffer under lock
              let seqNo = bufSeqNo buf
              atomically $ modifyTVar' (pendingAcks session) (Map.insert seqNo True)
              -- Simulate writing acknowledgment to buffer memory
              when (bufLen buf > 0) $ do
                poke (bufPtr buf) (fromIntegral seqNo)
  writeIORef (callbackRef session) (Just callback)

-- Simulates receiving a message from Kubernetes pod's MQ sidecar
receiveMessage :: ConsumerSession -> ByteString -> IO ()
receiveMessage session msg = do
  mcb <- readIORef (callbackRef session)
  case mcb of
    Nothing -> return ()
    Just cb -> void $ async (cb msg)

-- Rotate buffer: frees old buffer and allocates new one
-- This is called periodically by the health check probe
rotateBuffer :: ConsumerSession -> IO ()
rotateBuffer session = do
  modifyMVar_ (activeBuffer session) $ \oldBuf -> do
    case oldBuf of
      Nothing  -> return ()
      Just buf -> freeNativeBuffer buf
    -- Allocate new buffer
    newBuf <- allocNativeBuffer 1024 0
    return (Just newBuf)

-- Kubernetes liveness probe handler - rotates buffers
livenessProbe :: ConsumerSession -> IO Bool
livenessProbe session = do
  alive <- readTVarIO (sessionAlive session)
  when alive $ rotateBuffer session
  return alive

-- Graceful shutdown triggered by SIGTERM in pod
shutdownSession :: ConsumerSession -> IO ()
shutdownSession session = do
  atomically $ writeTVar (sessionAlive session) False
  -- Free the active buffer under lock
  modifyMVar_ (activeBuffer session) $ \oldBuf -> do
    case oldBuf of
      Nothing  -> return ()
      Just buf -> freeNativeBuffer buf
    return Nothing
  -- Remove from registry
  atomically $ modifyTVar' sessionRegistry (Map.delete (sessionId session))

-- Main consumer loop
runConsumer :: Int -> IO ()
runConsumer sid = do
  session <- newSession sid
  initBuf <- allocNativeBuffer 1024 1
  putMVar (activeBuffer session) (Just initBuf)
  registerCallback session
  -- Simulate message processing with concurrent health checks
  void $ async $ forever $ do
    threadDelay 5000000
    void $ livenessProbe session
  -- Process incoming messages
  forever $ do
    let msg = BS.pack "test-message"
    receiveMessage session msg
    threadDelay 100000
